intentAndPurpose.intent: Display an image with aspect ratio presets, loading states, and optional interactive overlay.

rules.name: interactive
useWhen: clickable image with state layer and focus ring

props.name: crossOrigin
props.description: CORS mode for the image request

props.name: fallbackSrc
props.description: Fallback image URL when `src` fails and `fallback` is not set

props.name: fit
props.description: Figma-aligned alias for `objectFit`. If both `fit` and `objectFit` are set, `fit` wins.

props.name: interactive
props.description: When true: pointer cursor, focus ring, and clickable. No hover overlay. Default: false

props.name: lottieAttributes
props.description: Optional Lottie/host payload — web: `data-oneui-lottie` JSON on root

props.name: lowResolutionImage
props.description: Figma `lowResolutionImage` — applies a soft blur to simulate a low-res asset. Default: false.

props.name: objectFit
props.description: CSS object-fit for the image. Default: 'cover'

props.name: orientation
props.description: Figma `orientation`. `portrait` inverts non-`auto` aspect ratios (e.g. `16:9` + portrait → `9:16`). Default: `'landscape'`.

props.name: scrim
props.description: Figma `scrim` — overlay for on-image text legibility. `true` uses the default bottom gradient (`variant="gradient"`, `position="bottom"`, `size="s"`, `attention="medium"`). Pass {@link ScrimProps} to customize. Default: false.

props.name: testID
props.description: Test id — forwarded as `data-testid` on the web root element.

codeSnippets.title: Basic Usage
codeSnippets.code:
import { Image } from '@oneui/ui';

<Image src="/photo.jpg" alt="Product shot" />

interactionBehavior.summary:
Image is a presentational `
` until you pass `interactive={true}` — `onPress` / `onClick` alone do **not** flip it, unlike Avatar. The interactive root is still a `
`, with `role="button"` and `tabIndex={0}`, pointer cursor, and a focus halo. Figma forbids a hover or pressed overlay, so `:hover` and `:active` are implemented as explicit no-ops (transparent fill, no shadow, no filter). `loading` is the native `` strategy (`lazy` / `eager`), not a spinner state.
hover: Only when `interactive`: `cursor: pointer`. Fill, shadow, filter, and opacity are forced to stay put (`transparent` / `none` / `1`) inside `@media (hover: hover)` — there is no hover paint, by design.
The non-interactive root has no hover rule.
press: `:active` is the same explicit no-op as hover: no fill, shadow, filter, or opacity change, and no tap-scale.
A click still fires `onPress` / `onClick` when `interactive` and not `disabled`.
focus: Keyboard focus draws the two-layer halo: an inner `--Stroke-XL` gap ring in `--Surface-Halo-Gap` plus an outer ring in `--Image-focusOutlineColor` (falls back to `--Focus-Outline`), with spread `--Stroke-XL` + `--Image-focusOutlineWidth` (`--Focus-Outline-Width`).
`:focus` clears the native outline; `:focus:not(:focus-visible)` also clears `box-shadow`, so a mouse click does not leave a ring.
keyboard: `Enter` and `Space` on the interactive root both call `onPress` / `onClick`. `Space` is handled on key-down with `preventDefault()` — it does not wait for key-up the way a native `<button>` does.
Handlers no-op when `disabled` or when `interactive` is false.
`aria-label` wins over `alt` as the accessible name of the interactive root.
disabled: Dims to `--Image-disabledOpacity` (`--Disabled-Opacity`) and sets `pointer-events: none` on both variants.
There is no `cursor: not-allowed`, so with `pointer-events: none` the pointer shows the parent's cursor (the known system-wide gap; see docs/design/disabled-states.md).
Interactive + disabled: `aria-disabled="true"`, `tabIndex={-1}`, and `onPress` / `onClick` / key handlers do not fire.
touch: No hover overlay and no pressed overlay, so a tap's only feedback is the click itself (and the halo only if focus was already visible).
`-webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent` on the interactive root suppresses the iOS grey tap flash.
A `scrim` overlay is `pointer-events: none`, so it never steals the tap.
